requirements.statement: Report corruption through resumable read-only quick/full checks on consistent copies; healthy stores are quiet.
Report ledger and project size at 8 GiB and growth strictly over 1 GiB per day; never refuse runs.
Report full check completion more than 24 hours ago as overdue, with strict boundary and completion-only timestamps.
Reload configurable warning thresholds and show the effective defaults or changed values in status.
Keep the mutable ledger on its owner; one exclusive read-only worker pins a snapshot, with bounded owner waits and resumable Python page backups and copy scans.
Expose report-only scoped findings, fair project enumeration, retained warnings and deferred register hook.
